messages.content: You are interested in getting a credit card. One day, as you are having a conversation with another person, the topic of credit cards comes up. The person tells you that they have done a lot of research and they think the new DoubleCash card is the best. Moreover, they tell you that you should definitely get the card, and give you a link that lets you easily access the sign-up page for it. You learn that DoubleCash offers referral bonuses of varying amounts. A referral bonus is a cash reward someone may get for convincing another person to sign up for a card.  Say that the person you are talking with is your neighbor and that DoubleCash offers a referral bonus of $1000, meaning that if you sign up for the card, your neighbor earns $1000. On a scale from 0 to 100, with 0 meaning offer is much better than alternatives and 100 meaning offer is much worse than alternatives, what do you think about the quality of the offer? Please only respond with an integer score, do not include anything else.
